config.cache_policy: clone native cache; write donor REC/Conv and only donor last-token KV according to frozen condition map; audit exact requested and untouched fields
config.calibration_status: diagnostic only; no V40 success claim or validation/final opening
config.continuation_policy: append d fixed neutral tokens immediately after fork, then shared encoded suffix; downstream native forward only
config.fork_policy: exact same encoded prefix and suffix, one differing natural token, preserve both native branches
config.invalid_policy: retain invalid state/condition records with explicit reason; do not drop from denominator silently
config.model_load_policy: local frozen Qwen/Falcon revisions and hashes; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES may remap physical GPU
config.raw_record_policy: immutable JSONL per unique run_id; reruns use a new run_id
config.score_policy: candidate IDs are tokenizer.encode(answer, add_special_tokens=false); all must be unique single tokens before model load
config.split_full_equivalence: record maximum absolute logit difference for native recipient and donor at delay 0; do not silently treat numerical drift as equality
